GamepadSettings(bool, float, float, float, HashSet<ShapeGamepadButton>?)

Initializes a new instance of the InputSettings.GamepadSettings struct with custom detection, axis, and trigger threshold values. Other values are set to their defaults: MinPressCount = 2, MinPressInterval = 1f, MinUsedDuration = 0.5f.

public GamepadSettings(bool detection, float axisThreshold, float triggerThreshold, float selectionCooldownDuration = 2, HashSet<ShapeGamepadButton>? exceptionButtons = null)

detection bool

Indicates whether gamepad detection is enabled.

axisThreshold float

triggerThreshold float

The minimum threshold for the triggers to consider the gamepad as "used".

Specifies the cooldown duration (in seconds) after this device is selected during which no other input device can be selected. Default is 2 seconds.

A set of gamepad buttons that will never select this device, even if pressed. Optional.

GamepadSettings(HashSet<ShapeGamepadButton>, float, HashSet<ShapeGamepadButton>?)

Initializes a new instance of the InputSettings.GamepadSettings class with a set of selection buttons, an optional cooldown duration, and optional exception buttons.

This constructor enables selection button mode, where only the specified selectionButtons can be used to select this device. All other detection methods are disabled by setting MinPressCount, MinPressInterval, and MinUsedDuration to -1.

TriggerThreshold is set to DefaultTriggerAxisThreshold, and AxisThreshold is set to DefaultJoyAxisThreshold. 

public GamepadSettings(HashSet<ShapeGamepadButton> selectionButtons, float selectionCooldownDuration = 2, HashSet<ShapeGamepadButton>? exceptionButtons = null)

Parameters

selectionButtons HashSet<ShapeGamepadButton>

The set of gamepad buttons that can be used to select this device. All other means of selection are disabled, even if an empty hash set is used.

selectionCooldownDuration float

Specifies the cooldown duration (in seconds) after this device is selected during which no other input device can be selected. Default is 2 seconds. Zero or negative values disable the cooldown.

exceptionButtons HashSet<ShapeGamepadButton>

A set of gamepad buttons that will never select this device, even if pressed. Optional.

GamepadSettings(int, float, float, HashSet<ShapeGamepadButton>?)

Initializes a new instance of the InputSettings.GamepadSettings class with custom minimum press count and interval, optional cooldown duration, and optional exception buttons.

Detection is set to true, TriggerThreshold is set to DefaultTriggerAxisThreshold, and AxisThreshold is set to DefaultJoyAxisThreshold, MinUsedDuration is disabled (-1).

GamepadSettings(float, float, int, float, float, float, HashSet<ShapeGamepadButton>?)

Initializes a new instance of the InputSettings.GamepadSettings struct with custom axis and trigger thresholds, minimum press count, minimum press interval, minimum used duration, and selection cooldown duration. Detection is set to true.

Fields

AxisThreshold

The minimum movement threshold for the left analog stick to consider the gamepad as "used". This effectively represents a movement detection deadzone for the left joystick. Value Range 0-1

public float AxisThreshold

Field Value

float

Remarks

Default is DefaultAxisThreshold Even if Detection is set to false, AxisThreshold will still be used for WasUsedRaw() system.

ExceptionButtons

public readonly HashSet<ShapeGamepadButton> ExceptionButtons

Field Value

HashSet<ShapeGamepadButton>

MinPressCount

The minimum number of gamepad button presses required, within the specified interval, to consider the gamepad device as "used".

public int MinPressCount

Field Value

int

Remarks

Default is 2 presses within 1 second. Does work in combination with MinUsedDuration but has a lower priority. MinUsedDuration system will be checked first and if it triggers, MinPressCount / MinPressInterval system will be reset as well and not checked in the same frame.

MinPressInterval

The time interval (in seconds) from the first gamepad button press within which MouseMinPressCount must be reached for the gamepad device to be considered "used".

public float MinPressInterval

Field Value

float

Remarks

Default is 1 second. Does work in combination with MinUsedDuration but has a lower priority. MinUsedDuration system will be checked first and if it triggers, MinPressCount / MinPressInterval system will be reset as well and not checked in the same frame.

MinUsedDuration

The minimum duration (in seconds) of consecutive gamepad use (movement or holding at least one button down) required to consider the gamepad device as "used".

public float MinUsedDuration

Field Value

float

Remarks

Default is 0.5 seconds Does work in combination with MinPressCount / MinPressInterval but has a higher priority. MinUsedDuration system will be checked first and if it triggers, MinPressCount / MinPressInterval system will be reset as well and not checked in the same frame.

SelectionButtons

The set of gamepad buttons that can be used to select this device. When set and not empty, all other means of selection are disabled.

public readonly HashSet<ShapeGamepadButton> SelectionButtons

Field Value

HashSet<ShapeGamepadButton>

SelectionCooldownDuration

Specifies the duration (in seconds) after this device is selected during which no other input device can be selected. Used to prevent rapid switching between input devices.

public float SelectionCooldownDuration

Field Value

float

Remarks

Default is 2 seconds. Zero and negative values disable the cooldown.

TriggerThreshold

The minimum threshold for the left trigger to consider the gamepad as "used". This effectively represents a movement detection deadzone for the left trigger. Value Range 0-1

float
